Also he misappropriated public funds: he borrowed public funds from a state-owned enterprise (桐城市住宅建设公司) and gave to private individual, without proper approval. In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of “巨额财产来源不明罪” (unexplained huge property). However, the typical charge is “贪污罪” for public officials who accept bribes and misappropriate public funds. But the facts separate: (1) 受贿 (bribery), (2) 挪用公款 (misappropriation of public funds), (3) 巨额财产来源不明 (unexplained huge property). So three charges.
